text:
karen: FYI I opened docs PR #4821 to add a migration note and tiny examples for the Console observability update. Main pieces: dashboard JSON example, tracing-hook snippet tweak, and a short PromQL rollup. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821

tom: Nice. Quick scan: the Go tracing example assumes Trace.ID is already trimmed of 0x. We've seen customer confusion on that. Suggest adding a one-liner to normalize.

ying: Good catch. Proposed addition for Go: `id := strings.TrimPrefix(trace.ID.String(), "0x")` and for Python `trace_id = getattr(trace, 'id', None) or trace.id.hex()`. Also mention how sampling=false will drop some traces and can make cost attribution look lower than actual.

karen: I'll add both lines. Also I added a shell helper to bulk-remap panels that some customers asked for: ```bash
# remap metric name in exported dashboard JSON files
for f in dashboards/*.json; do
  jq '.panels |= (map(.targets |= map(if .expr then .expr |= gsub("console.cost_per_token"; "console.unit_cost") else . end)))' "$f" > tmp && mv tmp "$f"
done
```

tom: Love the jq example. Add a note to backup files first and to test in staging. Maybe show the `--dry-run` variant using `cp -n` or pushing to a `remap/` folder.

ying: Also add PromQL example for a 1h rollup: `sum(increase(console_unit_cost_total[1h])) by (team)` and a Grafana transform suggestion: divide by `sum(increase(request_count_total[1h]))` to get unit cost per request.

karen: Done. I also attempted to upload two small PNGs for before/after panels but assets-bot failed with path error. assets-bot: "error: path not found: /assets/images/docs/observability/console-migration"

assets-bot: created path /assets/images/docs/observability/console-migration and uploaded 2 files (panel-before.png, panel-after.png)

doc-bot: CI check: linkchecker found inline reference to `console.cost_per_token` in code block that should be backticked. Spelling: 1 suggestion. Lint: docs/md-lint warnings on codeblock fence language.

tom: I'll fix the backticks and the fence language. Also suggest noting that older SDKs (v0.9.x) used `RedwoodClient()` signature without `region` param; if customers copy snippet they may need to upgrade or add credentials.

ying: Short compatibility note added. Also flagged that the panel JSON includes an `id` field that might conflict on import; added instruction to delete `id` or set to null before importing.

karen: Updated PR with fixes, screenshots, jq snippet backup suggestion, PromQL, and SDK compatibility note. Pushed changes.

doc-bot: Running checks... linkcheck OK. Spelling: 0 warnings. CI: green.

release-bot: Staging deploy queued for branch docs/4821 — ETA 8m.

karen: I'll merge after staging looks good. Thanks all for quick reviews.

tom: :thumbsup: thanks Karen and Ying.

release-bot: Staging deploy completed. Docs hosted at https://docs.redwood.ai/console/observability-migration (staging).

karen: Merged and cherry-picked to main. Closing the PR. :tada:
